test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The solution is **beyond**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is beyond.
 
• Science, according to popular belief is a remote and enigmatic idea that is beyond the comprehension of ordinary minds and peace-loving people.
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Beyond - at or to the further side of.

 
 
• ​*For example : "He pointed to a spot beyond the streetlamp."*
 
 
 
• *​*Beyond is a preposition.
 
• Preposition: *A preposition is a word used to link nouns, pronouns**, or phrases to other words within a sentence.* 
 
 
• *​For example : On, Upon, Above, Before.*
 
 

4d:T
